subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should native and Codex sub-agents regain access to MiniMax Token Plan skill/bundle guidance, or should OpenClaw keep the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md bootstrap boundary and route Token Plan office workflows through explicit plugin, skill, ClawHub, or docs surfaces?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally enforce the narrow bootstrap boundary, while the issue asks for behavior that would weaken or special-case that boundary; automation cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Keep Boundary, Fix Proven Bugs
options.body: Keep sub-agent bootstrap limited to AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md and only repair provider/media bugs proven by live MiniMax Token Plan evidence.

options.title: Approve Explicit Token Plan Surface
options.body: Define a maintained plugin or bundle-style surface for MiniMax Token Plan office workflows and test it in sub-agent runs without restoring arbitrary skill-file inheritance.

options.title: Restore Skill Inheritance
options.body: Reopen broad sub-agent skill-file loading and accept the context-boundary and token-cost tradeoff as an intentional product change.

recommendation.title: Keep Boundary, Fix Proven Bugs
recommendation.body: Keep sub-agent bootstrap limited to AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md and only repair provider/media bugs proven by live MiniMax Token Plan evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Eva introduced the current sub-agent bootstrap boundary and is the clearest history owner for whether that contract should change.
